main_text.l: Crimen] Culpa mea, tua, Plaut. Vitium. Noxia. Fraus. Meritum. Capitale facinus, Cic. Noxa, Liv. Piaculi contracta commissio, Arnob.

Criminalis actio] Judicium capitis. Causa de capite, capitis. Certamen capitis & famæ. Res capitalis. Judicium damnatorium. Lis capitis, Cic. Capitale judicium, Quint. Criminaliter actio intenditur, Bud. Actio criminosa, Id.

Criminari aliquem] Crimen alicui movere, Suet. Objicere alicui probrum, Crimen objectare, inferre. In magnis criminibus, vel, criminis loco aliquid objicere. Vocare in crimen, Cic. Insimulare falsis criminibus, Ovid. Crimen alicui intentare, Quint. Intendere crimen in aliquem, Liv. Arguere de crimine. Incusare aliquem probri, Plaut. Raptare pro scelesto, Prop. Increpabantur hæc in eum, Sallust. Pulsari falso crimine, Claud. vid. Accusare.
Crispare] Frangere in gradus comam, Plin. Calamistris inurere, Cic. Ustulare ardente ferro crines, Pacuv. Vibrare, Virg.
Crispatus] Calamistrata coma, Cic. Vibrati calido ferro crines, Virg.
Crispitudo] Annuli comarum, Mart. vid. Cincinnus.
Crispus] Bene capillatus, Cic. Criniger, Lucan. Cirratus, Pers. Crispulus, Mart. Subcrispus, Var. Crinibus in nodum tortis homo, Mart.
Crista (1)] Cirrus. Apex, Plin. Insigne cristatum pavonis, Pallad.
(2) Plumeus apex] Cerda, Virg. Capitis summi insigne, Lucr.
Crocus] Croci, plu. Ovid. Spica Cilissa, Propert. Scal. Fila croci, Ovid. Crocum, Plaut.
Cruciabiliter] Per tormenta, Suet. Lateribus fodicatis, sulcatis, Amm.
Cruciare tormentis] Cruciatu afficere, Caes. Supplicio affi-cere,
